shared_context.topic: Taking NyQuil and Benadryl at the same time

snippets.output: It is not recommended to take NyQuil and Benadryl at the same time.
NyQuil is an over-the-counter (OTC) medication that contains dextromethorphan, doxylamine, and acetaminophen.
snippets.pattern_notes: Two parallel facts about one drug: class + composition.

snippets.output: Benadryl is an antihistamine that contains diphenhydramine.
snippets.pattern_notes: Two parallel facts about one drug: class + active ingredient.

snippets.output: Taking NyQuil and Benadryl together may increase the risk of drowsiness, dizziness, and other side effects.

Doxylamine is an active ingredient in NyQuil, and doxylamine can interact with diphenhydramine, which may increase the risk of anticholinergic side effects such as dry mouth, blurred vision, and constipation.
snippets.pattern_notes: Causal chain atoms 9-11 (doxylamine in Nyquil -> can interact with diphenhydramine -> anticholinergic effects), then enumerated effects 12-14. Primary B (mechanism); secondary A (enumeration).

snippets.output: Combining NyQuil and Benadryl may increase the risk of sedation and impaired cognitive function.
It is essential to follow the recommended dosage instructions for both NyQuil and Benadryl.
Consult with a healthcare professional before taking NyQuil and Benadryl together.
Consult with a pharmacist before taking NyQuil and Benadryl together.
snippets.pattern_notes: Single-atom kept separate from atom 18 (HCP consult); same topic but distinct professional. Possibly isolated-false-atom (label_in_general=false) per the guidelines idiom.

snippets.output: If you experience adverse effects from NyQuil and Benadryl or have concerns about taking NyQuil and Benadryl together, seek medical attention immediately.
snippets.pattern_notes: Two parallel triggers (adverse effects, concerns) sharing the same recommendation.
